ko.title: FOMC 의사록 읽기: 연준의 다음 금리 인하 움직임에서 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: 연방준비제도의 가장 최근 통화정책 회의 의사록이 이번 주에 발표될 예정입니다.

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: 투자자, 경제학자, 주택 구매자들은 이를 면밀히 읽어볼 것입니다.

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.
segments.tr: 의사록은 결정을 발표하는 문서가 아닙니다.

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: 대신 정책 결정자들이 금리 인하, 동결, 인상 사이의 선택을 어떻게 저울질했는지에 대한 더 자세한 설명을 제공합니다.

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 의사록의 의미, 의사록에서 찾아봐야 할 점, 그리고 그 표현이 시장과 가계 재정에 왜 중요한지 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## 의사록이란 무엇이며, 무엇이 아닌가

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)는 중앙은행의 정책 금리를 결정합니다.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: 각 회의가 끝난 지 몇 주 후에 연준은 토론 요약본을 공개합니다.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: 의사록은 속기록이 아니며, 대개 개별 관료의 이름을 명시하여 의견을 귀속시키지 않습니다.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: 대체로 "참석자들", "많은 참석자들", 또는 "소수의 참석자들"과 같이 집합적인 용어로 토론을 묘사합니다.

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: 그 표현은 대충 넘겨보기 쉽지만, 애널리스트들은 이를 하나의 신호로 취급합니다.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"여러"(Several) 또는 "일부"(Some)**는 의미 있는 소수가 견해를 가지고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"많은"(Many)**은 더 큰 그룹을 시사합니다.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"대다수"(Most) 또는 "거의 모든"(Almost all)**은 합의에 가까운 상태를 나타냅니다.

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"소수"(A few)**는 대개 작고 때로는 의견을 달리하는 그룹을 가리킵니다.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: 이러한 단어들이 한 회의록에서 다음 회의록으로 넘어가며 바뀌는 모습은 위원회가 합의에 가까워지고 있는지 아니면 더욱 분열되고 있는지 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## 이 발표가 각별한 주목을 받는 이유

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: 두 가지 전개가 독자들이 이번 의사록에 접근하는 방식을 형성하고 있습니다.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **부진한 고용 보고서.** 고용 둔화는 완화적 정책을 뒷받침하는 근거를 강화할 수 있습니다. 관료들은 또한 하나의 보고서가 단일 데이터 포인트일 뿐이며, 월간 수치는 종종 수정된다는 점을 지적할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **5%를 웃도는 미 국채 수익률.** 더 높은 장기 금리는 그 자체로 금융 여건을 긴축시킵니다. 이는 연준이 단기 금리로 무엇을 하든 기업과 가계의 차입 비용을 끌어올릴 수 있습니다. 관료들은 이러한 긴축이 추가 조치의 필요성을 줄이는지, 아니면 다른 대응을 요구하는 인플레이션이나 정부 차입에 대한 우려를 반영하는지에 대해 논의할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: 종합해 보면, 완화된 노동 시장과 높은 수익률은 위원회의 상충 관계를 뚜렷하게 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: 너무 일찍 금리를 인하하면 인플레이션을 다시 자극할 위험이 있습니다.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: 너무 오래 기다리면 고용 시장에 타격을 줄 위험이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## 애널리스트들이 주목할 다섯 가지 포인트

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. 위원회가 얼마나 분열되어 있는지

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: 가장 면밀히 관찰되는 대목은 정책 경로에 대한 다양한 견해를 설명하는 부분입니다.

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: 토론이 언제 금리를 인하할지, 일시 중단할지, 아니면 금리 인상이 여전히 가능한지에 맞춰져 있습니까?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: 금리 인상 가능성을 제기하는 소규모 그룹조차도 관료들이 방향을 정하지 못했다는 신호로 읽힐 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. 관료들이 인플레이션을 묘사하는 방식

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: 인플레이션이 연준의 2% 목표를 향해 진전을 이루고 있는지, 아니면 정체되고 있는지 찾아보십시오.

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: 독자들은 또한 서비스 가격, 주거비, 에너지 또는 관세와 같은 구체적인 압력에 대한 언급과, 관료들이 이를 일시적인 것으로 보는지 지속적인 것으로 보는지 주목할 것입니다.

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. 노동 시장을 읽어내는 방식

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: 부진한 고용 보고서 이후, 고용에 관한 언어는 중요합니다.

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: "냉각", "완화" 또는 "회복력"과 같은 표현은 관료들이 데이터를 어떻게 저울질하고 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: 더 가파른 경기 침체 위험에 대한 어떤 논의든 어조의 눈에 띄는 변화가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. 금융 여건과 수익률에 대한 견해

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: 관료들은 상승하는 국채 수익률, 시장 기능, 그리고 여전히 논의 중이라면 연준의 대차대조표 축소 속도에 대해 언급할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들이 더 높은 수익률을 연준의 긴축 작업 일부를 대신하는 것으로 보는지 이러한 구절들을 읽어보십시오.

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. 데이터 의존성에 대한 지침

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 종종 결정이 유입되는 데이터에 달려 있음을 강조합니다.

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: 의사록은 급여, 임금 상승률, 소비자물가 또는 인플레이션 기대치 등 어떤 지표에 가장 많이 기댈지를 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: 이는 독자들에게 다가오는 보고서 중 어떤 것이 가장 중요할 수 있는지 알려줍니다.

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## 문구가 시장을 움직일 수 있는 이유

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: 시장은 기대를 바탕으로 거래됩니다.

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: 의사록이 투자자들이 가정했던 것보다 인플레이션에 대해 더 신중한 것으로 읽힌다면 주식과 채권 가격이 변동할 수 있으며, 달러화도 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: 성장과 고용에 대해 더 우려하는 것으로 읽힌다면 반응은 반대 방향으로 흐를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: 반응은 대개 단기적입니다.

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: 의사록은 몇 주 전에 발생한 회의를 반영하며, 최신 데이터나 연준 연설은 그림을 빠르게 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: 애널리스트들은 또한 특정 구절이 무엇을 의미하는지에 대해 의견이 갈리는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: 어느 하루의 시장 움직임도 판결이 아닌 텍스트에 대한 하나의 읽기로 취급하십시오.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## 모기지 금리와 가계 예산에 의미하는 바

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: 모기지 금리는 연준의 정책 금리를 직접 따르지 않습니다.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: 대출 기관의 위험 가격 책정 및 모기지담보부증권(MBS)에 대한 투자자 수요와 함께 장기 국채 수익률을 추종하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: 그것이 높은 국채 수익률이 예비 주택 구매자와 재융자를 고민하는 사람들에게 중요한 이유입니다.

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **주택 구매자:** 금리는 쇼핑하는 날과 고정하는 날 사이에 바뀔 수 있습니다. 대출 기관에 금리 고정이 어떻게 작동하며 비용이 얼마나 드는지 물어보십시오.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **변동금리 부채가 있는 차입자:** 신용카드와 일부 주택담보대출(HELOC)은 연준의 정책 금리에 더 직접적으로 반응합니다. 인하 또는 동결은 인상과는 다르게 이에 영향을 미칠 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **저축자:** 예금 계좌와 양도성예금증서(CD)의 수익률은 은행마다 조정 속도가 다르지만 대개 정책 금리를 따릅니다.

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## 발표를 거시적 관점에서 유지하기

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: 의사록이 나올 때 기억해 둘 만한 몇 가지 주의 사항이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인은 미묘한 뉘앙스를 압축합니다.** 요약뿐만 아니라 가능하다면 실제 문구를 읽어보십시오.

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **의사록은 과거를 바라봅니다.** 이는 현재의 생각이 아니라 과거의 회의를 묘사합니다.

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **예측은 불확실합니다.** 경험 많은 애널리스트조차도 금리 변화의 시기와 규모를 종종 오판합니다.

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **독자마다 다른 결론을 도출합니다.** 독자에 따라 동일한 문장이 매파적이거나 비둘기파적으로 받아들여질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: 의사록은 연준이 금리를 인하할지, 동결할지, 인상할지 결정짓지 않을 것입니다.

segments.src: They can show how wide the disagreement is, which risks officials are most worried about, and which data they are watching.
segments.tr: 이는 불일치가 얼마나 큰지, 관료들이 가장 우려하는 위험이 무엇인지, 그리고 어떤 데이터를 주시하고 있는지 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: After a weak jobs report and with Treasury yields above 5%, that detail may matter more than usual for investors and borrowers.
segments.tr: 부진한 고용 보고서 이후이자 미 국채 수익률이 5%를 웃도는 상황에서, 그 세부 사항은 투자자와 차입자에게 평소보다 더 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information and education only.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 및 교육 목적으로만 제공됩니다.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: 투자, 세무 또는 재정 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Consider consulting a qualified professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: 재정적 결정을 내리기 전에 자격을 갖춘 전문가와 상담하는 것을 고려하십시오.

segments.src: Check the Federal Reserve's official website for the full text of the minutes.*
segments.tr: 의사록의 전문을 보려면 연방준비제도의 공식 웹사이트를 확인하세요.*

zh.title: 解读FOMC会议纪要：关注美联储下一次利率行动的信号

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: 美联储最近一次政策会议的纪要将于本周公布。

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: 投资者、经济学家和购房者将仔细阅读这些纪要。

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.
segments.tr: 会议纪要不会宣布具体的决定。

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: 但它们确实对决策者如何权衡降息、维持利率不变和加息之间的选择提供了更详细的说明。

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.
segments.tr: 本指南解释了什么是会议纪要、其中有哪些看点，以及为什么措辞对市场和家庭财务可能至关重要。

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## 什么是会议纪要，以及它不是什么

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: 联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）设定了中央银行的政策利率。

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: 每次会议结束几周后，美联储会发布一份讨论摘要。

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: 会议纪要不是逐字记录的文字稿，通常也不会将观点归于具体的某位官员。

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: 它们通常用集体的术语来描述讨论，例如“与许多参与者”、“许多参与者”或“少数参与者”。

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: 这些措辞很容易被快速掠过，但分析人士将其视为信号。

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **“几位”或“一些”** 表明有相当一部分少数人持某种观点。

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **“许多”** 表明群体规模更大。

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **“大多数”或“几乎所有”** 发出了接近共识的信号。

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **“少数”** 通常指向一个小型且有时持异议的群体。

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: 从一份纪到下一份纪要中这些词汇的变化，可以看出委员会是走向达成一致还是分歧进一步加大。

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## 为什么这次发布会备受关注

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: 有两个发展正在塑造读者解读这套会议纪要的方式。

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **一份疲软的就业报告。** 招聘放缓可能会增强放松货币政策的理由。官员们也可能指出，单一报告只是一个数据点，而且月度数据经常会被修正。

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **国债收益率超过5%。** 更高的长期收益率本身就会收紧金融状况。无论美联储对短期利率采取什么行动，它们都可能推高企业和家庭的借贷成本。官员们可能会讨论这种收紧是否减少了进一步采取行动的必要性，或者它是否反映了对通胀或政府借贷的担忧，从而需要不同的回应。

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: 总之，较为疲软的劳动力市场和高企的收益率使委员会需要权衡的利弊昭然若揭。

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: 过早降息可能会冒着重新点燃通胀的风险。

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: 等待太久则可能会损害就业市场。

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## 分析师将寻找的五个要点

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. 委员会的分歧程度

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: 最受密切关注的段落描述了对政策路径的各种看法。

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: 讨论是围绕何时降息、是否暂停，还是加息是否仍然可能展开的？

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: 即使是少数官员提出加息的可能性，也可以被解读为官员们对方向尚未定论的信号。

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. 官员们如何描述通胀

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: 寻找通胀是被描述为在朝着美联储2%的目标取得进展，还是在陷入停滞。

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: 读者还将关注对具体压力（如服务价格、住房成本、能源或关税）的提及，以及官员们认为这些压力是暂时的还是持续的。

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. 他们如何解读劳动力市场

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: 在发布疲软的就业报告后，关于就业的措辞至关重要。

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: 诸如“冷却”、“软化”或“具韧性”之类的短语显示了官员们是如何权衡数据的。

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: 任何关于更严重经济低迷风险的讨论都将是基调上的显著变化。

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. 对金融状况和收益率的看法

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: 官员们可能会对不断上升的国债收益率、市场功能以及美联储资产负债表缩减的速度（如果仍在讨论中）发表评论。

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: 阅读这些段落，了解决策者是否将更高的收益率视为美联储正在进行的部分紧缩工作。

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. 关于数据依赖性的指导

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: 决策者经常强调，决策取决于随后的数据。

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: 会议纪要可以显示他们最倾向于哪些指标，例如非农就业人数、工资增长、消费价格或通胀预期。

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: 这告诉读者接下来哪些即将发布的报告可能最为重要。

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## 为什么措辞会撼动市场

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: 市场依靠预期进行交易。

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: 如果会议纪要对通胀的表态比投资者假设的更为谨慎，股票和债券价格可能会发生变化，美元也可能会随之变动。

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: 如果它们对增长和就业表现出更多担忧，反应则可能恰好相反。

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: 市场的反应通常是短暂的。

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: 会议纪要反映的是几周前召开的会议，更新的数据或美联储的演讲可以迅速改变局面。

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: 分析师往往对某一段落的含义意见不一。

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: 应将任何单日市场的波动视为对文本的一种解读，而不是最终定论。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## 这对房贷利率和家庭预算意味着什么

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: 抵押贷款利率并不直接跟随美联储的政策利率。

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: 它们往往追踪长期国债收益率，以及贷方的风险定价和投资者对抵押贷款支持证券的需求。

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么高企的国债收益率对潜在买家和考虑再融资的人很重要的原因。

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **购房者：** 在你四处看房的日子和锁定利率的日子之间，利率可能会发生变化。向贷款机构询问利率锁定是如何运作的以及它们的成本是多少。

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **拥有浮动利率债务的借款人：** 信用卡和一些房屋净值信贷额度对美联储政策利率的反应更直接。降息或维持利率不变对这些债务的影响将与加息不同。

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **储户：** 储蓄账户和存单的收益率通常紧随政策利率，尽管不同银行调整的速度有所不同。

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## 理性看待政策发布

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: 会议纪要出台时，有几个注意事项值得铭记：

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **标题压缩了细微差别。** 如果可以的话，请阅读实际段落，而不仅仅是摘要。

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **会议纪要具有滞后性。** 它们描述的是过去的会议，不一定代表当前的思考。

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **预测具有不确定性。** 即使是有经验的分析师也经常会误判利率变动的时机和幅度。

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **不同的读者会得出不同的结论。** 根据读者的不同，同一句话可能会被解读为鹰派或鸽派。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: 会议纪要不会尘埃落定美联储究竟是会降息、维持利率不变还是加息。

segments.src: They can show how wide the disagreement is, which risks officials are most worried about, and which data they are watching.
segments.tr: 它们可以展示分歧有多大、官员们最担心哪些风险，以及他们在关注哪些数据。

segments.src: After a weak jobs report and with Treasury yields above 5%, that detail may matter more than usual for investors and borrowers.
segments.tr: 在发布疲软的就业报告且国债收益率超过5%的情况下，这些细节对投资者和借款人而言可能比以往更加重要。

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## मिनट क्या हैं, और क्या नहीं हैं

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: फेडरल ओपन मार्केट कमेटी (FOMC) केंद्रीय बैंक की नीतिगत दर तय करती है।

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक बैठक के कुछ हफ़्ते बाद, फेड चर्चा का सारांश प्रकाशित करता है।

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: मिनट कोई शब्दशः प्रतिलिपि नहीं हैं, और वे आमतौर पर व्यक्तिगत अधिकारियों के नाम से उनके विचारों को नहीं जोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: वे आम तौर पर चर्चा का वर्णन सामूहिक शब्दों में करते हैं, जैसे "प्रतिभागी", "कई प्रतिभागी" या "कुछ प्रतिभागी"।

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: उस शब्दावली को सरसरी तौर पर पढ़ना आसान है, लेकिन विश्लेषक इसे एक संकेत के रूप में मानते हैं।

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"कई" या "कुछ"** यह सुझाव देता है कि एक सार्थक अल्पसंख्यक का एक विचार है।

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"अनेक"** एक बड़े समूह का सुझाव देता है।

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"अधिकांश" या "लगभग सभी"** सर्वसम्मति के करीब किसी चीज़ का संकेत देता है।

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"कुछ"** आमतौर पर एक छोटे, कभी-कभी असहमत समूह की ओर इशारा करता है।

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: मिनट के एक सेट से दूसरे सेट तक इन शब्दों में बदलाव यह दिखा सकता है कि क्या समिति समझौते की ओर बढ़ रही है या और अधिक विभाजित हो रही है।

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## यह रिलीज़ अतिरिक्त ध्यान क्यों आकर्षित कर रही है

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: दो विकास यह आकार दे रहे हैं कि पाठक मिनटों के इस सेट के पास कैसे पहुंचते हैं।

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **एक कमजोर रोजगार रिपोर्ट।** धीमी नियुक्ति नीति को आसान बनाने के मामले को मजबूत कर सकती है। अधिकारी यह भी इंगित कर सकते हैं कि एक रिपोर्ट एक ही डेटा बिंदु है, और मासिक आंकड़े अक्सर संशोधित होते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **ट्रेजरी यील्ड 5% से ऊपर।** उच्च दीर्घकालिक यील्ड अपने दम पर वित्तीय स्थितियों को सख्त करती हैं। फेड अपनी अल्पकालिक दर के साथ जो कुछ भी करता है, वे व्यवसायों और परिवारों के लिए उधार लेने की लागत बढ़ा सकते हैं। अधिकारी चर्चा कर सकते हैं कि क्या वह सख्तीकरण आगे की कार्रवाई की आवश्यकता को कम करता है, या क्या यह मुद्रास्फीति या सरकारी उधार के बारे में चिंताओं को दर्शाता है जो एक अलग प्रतिक्रिया की मांग करते हैं।

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: एक साथ, एक नरम श्रम बाजार और ऊंचे यील्ड समिति के ट्रेड-ऑफ़ को स्पष्ट रूप से सामने रखते हैं।

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: बहुत जल्दी कटौती करने से मुद्रास्फीति को फिर से भड़काने का जोखिम हो सकता है।

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: बहुत देर तक इंतजार करने से नौकरी बाजार को नुकसान पहुंचने का जोखिम हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## पांच चीजें जिन पर विश्लेषक नजर रखेंगे

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. समिति कितनी विभाजित है

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: सबसे बारीकी से देखे जाने वाले अंश नीति पथ पर विचारों की श्रृंखला का वर्णन करते हैं।

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: क्या चर्चा इस बात पर केंद्रित है कि कब कटौती करनी है, क्या रोक लगानी है, या क्या ब्याज दर में वृद्धि अभी भी संभव है?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: यहाँ तक कि एक छोटा समूह जो बढ़ोतरी की संभावना उठा रहा है, उसे इस संकेत के रूप में पढ़ा जा सकता है कि अधिकारी दिशा पर तय नहीं हैं।

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. अधिकारी मुद्रास्फीति का वर्णन कैसे करते हैं

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: इस बात की तलाश करें कि क्या मुद्रास्फीति को फेड के 2% लक्ष्य की ओर प्रगति करने के रूप में वर्णित किया गया है, या रुकने के रूप में।

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: पाठकों विशिष्ट दबावों के उल्लेख पर भी नजर रखेंगे, जैसे सेवाओं की कीमतें, आवास लागत, ऊर्जा या शुल्क, और क्या अधिकारी उन्हें अस्थायी या लगातार मानते हैं।

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. वे श्रम बाजार को कैसे पढ़ते हैं

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: एक कमजोर रोजगार रिपोर्ट के बाद, रोजगार पर भाषा मायने रखती है।

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: "ठंडा होना", "नरम होना" या "लचीला" जैसे वाक्यांश दिखाते हैं कि अधिकारी डेटा का वजन कैसे कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: एक तेज मंदी के जोखिम की कोई भी चर्चा स्वर में एक उल्लेखनीय बदलाव होगी।

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. वित्तीय स्थितियों और यील्ड पर विचार

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: अधिकारी बढ़ती ट्रेजरी यील्ड, बाजार के कामकाज और फेड की बैलेंस शीट में कटौती की गति पर टिप्पणी कर सकते हैं, यदि वह अभी भी चर्चा में है।

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: इन अंशों को इस बात के लिए पढ़ें कि क्या नीति निर्माता उच्च यील्ड को फेड के कड़े काम का कुछ हिस्सा करते हुए देखते हैं।

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. डेटा निर्भरता पर मार्गदर्शन

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माता अक्सर इस बात पर जोर देते हैं कि निर्णय आने वाले डेटा पर निर्भर करते हैं।

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: मिनट यह दिखा सकते हैं कि वे किन संकेतकों पर सबसे अधिक झुक रहे हैं, जैसे पेरोल, वेतन वृद्धि, उपभोक्ता कीमतें या मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदें।

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: यह पाठकों को बताता है कि कौन सी आगामी रिपोर्टें सबसे अधिक मायने रख सकती हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## शब्दों का चयन बाजारों को क्यों हिला सकता है

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: बाजार उम्मीदों पर व्यापार करते हैं।

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: यदि मिनट निवेशकों की धारणा की तुलना में मुद्रास्फीति के बारे में अधिक सतर्क दिखते हैं, तो स्टॉक और बॉन्ड की कीमतें बदल सकती हैं, और डॉलर भी हिल सकता है।

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: यदि वे विकास और नौकरियों के बारे में अधिक चिंतित दिखाई देते हैं, तो प्रतिक्रिया दूसरी तरह जा सकती है।

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: प्रतिक्रियाएं अक्सर अल्पकालिक होती हैं।

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: मिनट उस बैठक को दर्शाते हैं जो हफ्तों पहले हुई थी, और नया डेटा या फेड के भाषण तस्वीर को जल्दी से बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक भी इस बात पर असहमत होते हैं कि किसी दिए गए मार्ग का क्या अर्थ है।

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: किसी भी एक दिन के बाजार की चाल को पाठ का एक पाठ मानें, कोई फैसला नहीं।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## बंधक दरों और घरेलू बजट के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: बंधक दरें सीधे फेड की नीतिगत दर का पालन नहीं करती हैं।

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: वे लंबे समय के ट्रेजरी यील्ड, उधारदाताओं के जोखिम मूल्य निर्धारण और बंधक-समर्थित प्रतिभूतियों के लिए निवेशक की मांग के साथ ट्रैक करते हैं।

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि ऊंचे ट्रेजरी यील्ड संभावित खरीदारों और पुनर्वित्त के बारे में सोचने वाले लोगों के लिए मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **घर खरीदार:** दरें उस दिन के बीच बदल सकती हैं जब आप खरीदारी करते हैं और जिस दिन आप लॉक करते हैं। किसी ऋणदाता से पूछें कि दर लॉक कैसे काम करते हैं और उनकी लागत क्या है।

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **परिवर्तनीय-दर ऋण वाले उधारकर्ता:** क्रेडिट कार्ड और कुछ गृह इक्विटी लाइनें फेड की नीतिगत दर पर अधिक सीधे प्रतिक्रिया करती हैं। एक कटौती या होल्ड इन पर बढ़ोतरी की तुलना में अलग तरह से प्रभाव डालेगा।

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **बचतकर्ता:** बचत खातों और जमा प्रमाणपत्रों पर यील्ड अक्सर नीतिगत दर का पालन करते हैं, हालांकि बैंक इस बात में भिन्न होते हैं कि वे कितनी जल्दी समायोजित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## रिलीज को परिप्रेक्ष्य में रखना

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: जब मिनट बाहर आते हैं तो कुछ सावधानियां याद रखने योग्य होती हैं:

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **हेडलाइन सूक्ष्मता को संपीड़ित करती हैं।** यदि आप कर सकते हैं तो वास्तविक मार्ग पढ़ें, न कि केवल सारांश।

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **मिनट पीछे मुड़कर देखते हैं।** वे पिछली बैठक का वर्णन करते हैं, जरूरी नहीं कि वर्तमान सोच का।

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **पूर्वानुमान अनिश्चित हैं।** अनुभवी विश्लेषक भी अक्सर दर परिवर्तन के समय और आकार का गलत आकलन करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **विभिन्न पाठक अलग-अलग निष्कर्ष निकालते हैं।** पाठक के आधार पर एक ही वाक्य को आक्रामक या नरम माना जा सकता है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## मुख्य बात

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: मिनट यह तय नहीं करेंगे कि फेड कटौती करेगा, होल्ड करेगा या बढ़ोतरी करेगा।

segments.src: They can show how wide the disagreement is, which risks officials are most worried about, and which data they are watching.
segments.tr: वे यह दिखा सकते हैं कि असहमति कितनी व्यापक है, अधिकारी किन जोखिमों से सबसे अधिक चिंतित हैं, और वे किस डेटा को देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: After a weak jobs report and with Treasury yields above 5%, that detail may matter more than usual for investors and borrowers.
segments.tr: एक कमजोर रोजगार रिपोर्ट के बाद और 5% से ऊपर ट्रेजरी यील्ड के साथ, वह विवरण निवेशकों और उधारकर्ताओं के लिए सामान्य से अधिक मायने रख सकता है।

segments.src: *This article is for general information and education only.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी और शिक्षा के लिए है।

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: यह निवेश, कर या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Consider consulting a qualified professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: वित्तीय निर्णय लेने से पहले किसी योग्य पेशेवर से परामर्श करने पर विचार करें।

segments.src: Check the Federal Reserve's official website for the full text of the minutes.*
segments.tr: मिनट के पूर्ण पाठ के लिए फेडरल रिजर्व की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट देखें।*

es.title: Lectura de las actas del FOMC: qué tener en cuenta en la próxima decisión sobre tipos de la Fed

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: Las actas de la reunión de política más reciente de la Reserva Federal se publicarán esta semana.

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: Inversores, economistas y compradores de vivienda las leerán detenidamente.

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.
segments.tr: Las actas no anuncian una decisión.

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: Sí ofrecen un relato más detallado de cómo los responsables de la política monetaria sopesaron la opción entre recortar, mantener o subir los tipos de interés.

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica qué son las actas, qué buscar en ellas y por qué la redacción puede importar para los mercados y las finanzas de los hogares.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## Qué son las actas y qué no son

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: El Comité Federal de Mercado Abierto (FOMC) fija el tipo de interés de referencia del banco central.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: Unas semanas después de cada reunión, la Fed publica un resumen del debate.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: Las actas no son una transcripción literal y normalmente no atribuyen opiniones a funcionarios individuales por su nombre.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: Por lo general, describen el debate en términos colectivos, como "participantes", "muchos participantes" o "unos pocos participantes".

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: Esa redacción es fácil de pasar por alto, pero los analistas la tratan como una señal.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"Varios" o "algunos"** sugiere que una minoría significativa mantiene un punto de vista.

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"Muchos"** sugiere un grupo más numeroso.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"La mayoría" o "casi todos"** indica algo cercano a un consenso.

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"Unos pocos"** suele apuntar a un grupo pequeño, a veces disidente.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: Los cambios en estas palabras de unas actas a otras pueden mostrar si el comité avanza hacia un acuerdo o se divide aún más.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## Por qué esta publicación está atraiendo atención adicional

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: Dos acontecimientos están configurando la forma en que los lectores abordan este conjunto de actas.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **Un informe de empleo débil.** Una contratación más lenta puede reforzar los argumentos a favor de una política más flexible. Los funcionarios también pueden señalar que un informe es un único dato y que las cifras mensuales suelen revisarse.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **Rendimientos del Tesoro por encima del 5%.** Unos rendimientos a largo plazo más altos endurecen las condiciones financieras por sí mismos. Pueden aumentar los costes de endeudamiento para las empresas y los hogares, independientemente de lo que haga la Fed con su tipo a corto plazo. Los funcionarios pueden debatir si ese endurecimiento reduce la necesidad de más medidas o si refleja preocupaciones sobre la inflación o el endeudamiento público que exigen una respuesta diferente.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: Juntos, un mercado laboral más débil y unos rendimientos elevados ponen de relieve las contrapartidas del comité.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: Recortar demasiado pronto podría correr el riesgo de reavivar la inflación.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: Esperar demasiado podría dañar el mercado laboral.

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## Cinco cosas que los analistas buscarán

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. Cuán dividido está el comité

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: Los pasajes más seguidos describen el abanico de opiniones sobre la trayectoria de la política monetaria.

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: ¿El debate gira en torno a cuándo recortar, si hacer una pausa o si sigue siendo posible una subida de tipos?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: Incluso un pequeño grupo que plantee la posibilidad de una subida puede interpretarse como una señal de que los funcionarios no tienen clara la dirección.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. Cómo describen los funcionarios la inflación

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: Busque si se describe que la inflación está progresando hacia el objetivo del 2% de la Fed o si se está estancando.

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: Los lectores también estarán atentos a las menciones de presiones específicas, como los precios de los servicios, los costes de la vivienda, la energía o los aranceles, y si los funcionarios los consideran temporales o persistentes.

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. Cómo interpretan el mercado laboral

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: Tras un informe de empleo débil, el lenguaje sobre el empleo importa.

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: Frases como "enfriamiento", "ablandamiento" o "resiliente" muestran cómo los funcionarios están sopesando los datos.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: Cualquier debate sobre el riesgo de una recesión más pronunciada supondría un cambio notable en el tono.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. Opiniones sobre las condiciones financieras y los rendimientos

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios pueden comentar sobre el aumento de los rendimientos del Tesoro, el funcionamiento del mercado y el ritmo de reducción del balance de la Fed, si es que eso sigue en debate.

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: Lea estos pasajes para ver si los responsables políticos consideran que los rendimientos más altos están haciendo parte del trabajo de endurecimiento de la Fed.

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. Orientación sobre la dependencia de los datos

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: Los responsables políticos suelen destacar que las decisiones dependen de los datos entrantes.

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Las actas pueden mostrar en qué indicadores se apoyan más, como las nóminas, el crecimiento de los salarios, los precios al consumo o las expectativas de inflación.

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## Por qué la redacción puede mover los mercados

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: Los mercados operan en función de las expectativas.

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: Si las actas se interpretan como más cautelosas con respecto a la inflación de lo que suponían los inversores, los precios de las acciones y los bonos pueden cambiar, y el dólar también puede moverse.

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: Si se interpretan como más preocupadas por el crecimiento y el empleo, la reacción puede ir en sentido contrario.

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: Las reacciones suelen ser de corta duración.

segments.tr: Las actas reflejan una reunión que tuvo lugar hace semanas, y unos datos más recientes o los discursos de la Fed pueden cambiar el panorama rápidamente.

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.

segments.tr: Trate cualquier movimiento del mercado de un solo día como una lectura del texto, no como un veredicto.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar para los tipos hipotecarios y los presupuestos familiares

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: Los tipos hipotecarios no siguen directamente el tipo de interés de la Fed.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: Suelen seguir los rendimientos del Tesoro a más largo plazo, junto con la fijación de precios de riesgo de los prestamistas y la demanda de los inversores de valores respaldados por hipotecas.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: Por eso los rendimientos elevados del Tesoro importan a los futuros compradores y a las personas que piensan en refinanciar.

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **Compradores de vivienda:** Los tipos pueden cambiar entre el día en que busca y el día en que fija el tipo. Pregunte a un prestamista cómo funcionan los bloqueos de tipos y cuánto cuestan.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **Prestatarios con deuda a tipo variable:** Las tarjetas de crédito y algunas líneas de crédito sobre el valor de la vivienda responden más directamente al tipo de interés de la Fed. Un recorte o una pausa afectarían a esto de manera diferente a una subida.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **Ahorradores:** Los rendimientos de las cuentas de ahorros y los certificados de depósito suelen seguir el tipo de interés, aunque los bancos varían en la rapidez con la que se ajustan.

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## Mantener la publicación en perspectiva

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: Vale la pena recordar algunas precauciones cuando se publican las actas:

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **Los titulares comprimen los matices.** Lea los pasajes reales si puede, no solo los resúmenes.

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **Las actas miran hacia atrás.** Describen una reunión pasada, no necesariamente el pensamiento actual.

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **Las previsiones son inciertas.** Incluso los analistas experimentados suelen juzgar mal el momento y la magnitud de los cambios de tipos.

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **Diferentes lectores sacan diferentes conclusiones.** La misma frase puede tomarse como de línea dura o flexible según el lector.

segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: Las actas no zanjarán si la Fed va a recortar, mantener o subir los tipos.

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: من المقرر صدور محاضر اجتماع السياسة النقدية الأخير للاحتياطي الفيدرالي هذا الأسبوع.

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: سيقرؤها المستثمرون والاقتصاديون ومشتري المنازل بعناية.

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: لكنها تقدم وصفاً أكثر تفصيلاً لكيفية موازنة صناع السياسات بين خيارات خفض أسعار الفائدة، أو تثبيتها، أو رفعها.

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## ما هي المحاضر، وما هي ليست كذلك

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: تحدد اللجنة الفيدرالية للسوق المفتوحة (FOMC) سعر الفائدة للبنك المركزي.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: بعد بضعة أسابيع من كل اجتماع، ينشر الاحتياطي الفيدرالي ملخصاً للمناقشة.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: المحاضر ليست نصاً حرفياً، وعادة لا تنسب الآراء إلى مسؤولين محددين بالاسم.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: وعادة ما تصف المناقشة بمصطلحات جماعية، مثل "المشاركون"، أو "العديد من المشاركين"، أو "بعض المشاركين".

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: هذه الصياغة يسهل تجاوزها، لكن المحللين يعاملونها كإشارة.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"العديد" (Several) أو "بعض" (some)** تشير إلى أن أقلية ذات أهمية تحمل وجهة نظر معينة.

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"كثير" (Many)** تشير إلى مجموعة أكبر.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"معظم" (Most) أو "كلهم تقريباً" (almost all)** تشير إلى شيء قريب من الإجماع.

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"قليل" (A few)** تشير عادة إلى مجموعة صغيرة، وأحياناً معارضة.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تظهر التحولات في هذه الكلمات من محضر إلى آخر ما إذا كانت اللجنة تتجه نحو الاتفاق أو تزداد انقساماً.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## لماذا يجذب هذا الإصدار اهتماماً إضافياً

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: هناك تطوران يشكلان كيفية تعامل القراء مع هذه المجموعة من المحاضر.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **تقرير وظائف ضعيف.** يمكن أن يؤدي تباطؤ التوظيف إلى تعزيز الحجة لتخفيف السياسة النقدية. قد يشير المسؤولون أيضاً إلى أن تقريراً واحداً هو مجرد نقطة بيانات واحدة، وغالباً ما تتم مراجعة الأرقام الشهرية.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **عائدات سندات الخزانة فوق 5%.** تؤدي العائدات طويلة الأجل المرتفعة إلى تشديد الظروف المالية من تلقاء نفسها. يمكن أن ترفع تكاليف الاقتراض للشركات والأسر بغض النظر عما يفعله الاحتياطي الفيدرالي بسعر الفائدة قصير الأجل. قد يناقش المسؤولون ما إذا كان هذا التشديد يقلل من الحاجة إلى اتخاذ مزيد من الإجراءات، أو ما إذا كان يعكس مخاوف بشأن التضخم أو الاقتراض الحكومي التي تستدعي استجابة مختلفة.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: معاً، يضع سوق العمل الأكثر ليونة والعائدات المرتفعة مقايضات اللجنة في العلن.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: الخفض في وقت مبكر جداً قد يخاطر بإعادة إشعال التضخم.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: الانتظار لفترة طويلة جداً قد يخاطر بالإضرار بسوق العمل.

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## خمسة أشياء سيبحث عنها المحللون

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. مدى انقسام اللجنة

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: المقاطع الأكثر مراقبة هي التي تصف نطاق الآراء حول مسار السياسة النقدية.

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: هل تتمحور المناقشة حول متى يتم الخفض، أو ما إذا كان يجب التوقف مؤقتاً، أو ما إذا كان رفع سعر الفائدة لا يزال ممكناً؟

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: حتى مجموعة صغيرة تثير احتمال رفع الفائدة يمكن قراءتها كعلامة على أن المسؤولين لم يستقروا على اتجاه معين.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. كيف يصف المسؤولون التضخم

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: ابحث عما إذا كان التضخم يوصف بأنه يحرز تقدماً نحو هدف الاحتياطي الفيدرالي البالغ 2%، أو بأنه يتعثر.

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: سيراقب القراء أيضاً الإشارات إلى ضغوط محددة، مثل أسعار الخدمات، وتكاليف الإسكان، والطاقة أو التعريفات الجمركية، وما إذا كان المسؤولون يرونها مؤقتة أم مستمرة.

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. كيف يقرؤون سوق العمل

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: بعد تقرير وظائف ضعيف، فإن اللغة المستخدمة بشأن التوظيف مهمة.

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: عبارات مثل "يبرد"، أو "يتباطأ"، أو "مرن" تظهر كيف يزن المسؤولون البيانات.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: أي مناقشة لخطر حدوث تراجع حاد ستكون تغييراً ملحوظاً في النبرة.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. الآراء حول الظروف المالية والعائدات

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: قد يعلق المسؤولون على ارتفاع عائدات سندات الخزانة، وعمل الأسواق، ووتيرة تقليص الميزانية العمومية للاحتياطي الفيدرالي، إذا كان ذلك لا يزال قيد المناقشة.

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: اقرأ هذه المقاطع لمعرفة ما إذا كان صناع السياسات يرون أن العائدات المرتفعة تقوم ببعض أعمال التشديد الخاصة بالاحتياطي الفيدرالي.

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. التوجيه بشأن الاعتماد على البيانات

segments.tr: غالباً ما يؤكد صناع السياسات أن القرارات تعتمد على البيانات الواردة.

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets

fr.title: Lecture du compte-rendu du FOMC : ce qu'il faut surveiller concernant la prochaine décision de taux de la Fed

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: Le compte-rendu de la réunion de politique monétaire la plus récente de la Réserve fédérale est attendu cette semaine.

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs, les économistes et les acheteurs immobiliers les liront attentivement.

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.
segments.tr: Le compte-rendu n'annonce pas de décision.

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: Il offre un compte-rendu plus détaillé de la manière dont les décideurs politiques ont pesé le choix entre réduire, maintenir ou augmenter les taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique ce qu'est le compte-rendu, ce qu'il faut y rechercher et pourquoi la formulation peut avoir de l'importance pour les marchés et les finances des ménages.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'est le compte-rendu, et ce qu'il n'est pas

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: Le Comité fédéral de l'open market (FOMC) fixe le taux directeur de la banque centrale.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: Quelques semaines après chaque réunion, la Fed publie un résumé de la discussion.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: Le compte-rendu n'est pas une transcription mot à mot, et il n'attribue généralement pas les points de vue à des responsables individuels par leur nom.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: Il décrit généralement la discussion en termes collectifs, tels que "les participants", "de nombreux participants" ou "quelques participants".

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: Cette formulation est facile à survoler, mais les analystes la traitent comme un signal.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"Plusieurs" ou "certains"** suggèrent qu'une minorité significative détient un point de vue.

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"De nombreux"** suggère un groupe plus large.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"La plupart" ou "presque tous"** signale quelque chose proche d'un consensus.

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"Quelques"** pointe généralement vers un petit groupe, parfois dissident.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: Les changements dans ces mots d'un compte-rendu à l'autre peuvent montrer si le comité se dirige vers un accord ou s'il se divise davantage.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette publication attire une attention particulière

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: Deux développements façonnent la manière dont les lecteurs abordent cet ensemble de compte-rendus.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **Un rapport sur l'emploi faible.** Un ralentissement des embauches peut renforcer les arguments en faveur d'un assouplissement de la politique. Les responsables peuvent également souligner qu'un rapport n'est qu'un point de données unique, et que les chiffres mensuels sont souvent révisés.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **Des rendements du Trésor supérieurs à 5 %.** Des rendements à long terme plus élevés resserrent les conditions financières par eux-mêmes. Ils peuvent augmenter les coûts d'emprunt pour les entreprises et les ménages, quoi que fasse la Fed avec son taux à court terme. Les responsables peuvent discuter si ce resserrement réduit le besoin d'une action supplémentaire, ou s'il reflète des préoccupations concernant l'inflation ou l'emprunt public qui appellent une réponse différente.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: Ensemble, un marché du travail plus faible et des rendements élevés mettent en évidence les compromis du comité.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: Réduire trop tôt pourrait risquer de relancer l'inflation.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: Attendre trop longtemps pourrait risquer de nuire au marché du travail.

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## Cinq choses que les analystes vont rechercher

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. À quel point le comité est divisé

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: Les passages les plus surveillés décrivent l'éventail des points de vue sur la trajectoire politique.

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: La discussion est-elle structurée autour du moment de la réduction, de la nécessité d'une pause, ou de la possibilité d'une hausse des taux ?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: Même un petit groupe soulevant la possibilité d'une hausse peut être interprété comme un signe que les responsables ne sont pas fixés sur la direction à prendre.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. Comment les responsables décrivent l'inflation

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: Cherchez si l'inflation est décrite comme progressant vers l'objectif de 2 % de la Fed, ou comme stagnante.

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs surveilleront également les mentions de pressions spécifiques, telles que les prix des services, les coûts du logement, l'énergie ou les tarifs douaniers, et si les responsables les considèrent comme temporaires ou persistantes.

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. Comment ils lisent le marché du travail

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: Après un rapport sur l'emploi faible, le langage sur l'emploi compte.

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: Des expressions comme "refroidissement", "assouplissement" ou "résilient" montrent comment les responsables pèsent les données.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: Toute discussion sur le risque d'un ralentissement plus marqué serait un changement de ton notable.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. Points de vue sur les conditions financières et les rendements

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: Les responsables peuvent commenter la hausse des rendements du Trésor, le fonctionnement du marché et le rythme de la réduction du bilan de la Fed, si cela est toujours en discussion.

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: Lisez ces passages pour voir si les décideurs politiques considèrent que des rendements plus élevés effectuent une partie du travail de resserrement de la Fed.

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. Orientation sur la dépendance aux données

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques soulignent souvent que les décisions dépendent des données entrantes.

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Le compte-rendu peut montrer sur quels indicateurs ils s'appuient le plus, tels que les salaires, la croissance des salaires, les prix à la consommation ou les anticipations d'inflation.

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: Cela indique aux lecteurs quels rapports à venir pourraient avoir le plus d'importance.

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la formulation peut faire bouger les marchés

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: Les marchés négocient sur la base des attentes.

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: Si le compte-rendu semble plus prudent concernant l'inflation que ce que les investisseurs supposaient, les prix des actions et des obligations peuvent changer, et le dollar peut également bouger.

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: S'ils semblent plus préoccupés par la croissance et l'emploi, la réaction peut aller dans l'autre sens.

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: Les réactions sont souvent de courte durée.

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: Le compte-rendu reflète une réunion qui a eu lieu il y a des semaines, et des données plus récentes ou des discours de la Fed peuvent changer rapidement la donne.

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: Les analystes ont également tendance à ne pas être d'accord sur ce qu'un passage donné signifie.

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Traitez le mouvement de marché d'une journée donnée comme une lecture du texte, pas comme un verdict.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les taux hypothécaires et les budgets des ménages

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: Les taux hypothécaires ne suivent pas directement le taux directeur de la Fed.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: Ils ont tendance à suivre les rendements du Trésor à plus long terme, ainsi que la tarification du risque des prêteurs et la demande des investisseurs pour les titres adossés à des créances hypothécaires.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi des rendements du Trésor élevés comptent pour les acheteurs potentiels et les personnes envisageant un refinancement.

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **Acheteurs immobiliers :** Les taux peuvent changer entre le jour où vous magasinez et le jour où vous verrouillez. Demandez à un prêteur comment fonctionnent les verrouillages de taux et combien ils coûtent.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **Emprunteurs avec une dette à taux variable :** Les cartes de crédit et certaines marges de crédit sur valeur domiciliaire réagissent plus directement au taux directeur de la Fed. Une réduction ou un maintien affecterait ces derniers différemment d'une hausse.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **Épargnants :** Les rendements sur les comptes d'épargne et les certificats de dépôt suivent souvent le taux directeur, bien que les banques varient dans la rapidité avec laquelle elles s'ajustent.

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## Garder la publication en perspective

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: Quelques mises en garde valent la peine d'être rappelées lorsque le compte-rendu est publié :

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **Les gros titres compressent la nuance.** Lisez les passages réels si vous le pouvez, pas seulement les résumés.

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **Le compte-rendu regarde en arrière.** Il décrit une réunion passée, pas nécessairement la réflexion actuelle.

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **Les prévisions sont incertaines.** Même des analystes expérimentés jugent souvent mal le moment et l'ampleur des changements de taux.

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **Différents lecteurs tirent des conclusions différentes.** La même phrase peut être interprétée comme belliciste ou colombe selon le lecteur.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: Le compte-rendu ne tranchera pas si la Fed va réduire, maintenir ou augmenter les taux.

segments.src: They can show how wide the disagreement is, which risks officials are most worried about, and which data they are watching.
segments.tr: Il peut montrer à quel point le désaccord est large, quels risques préoccupent le plus les responsables, et quelles données ils surveillent.

segments.src: After a weak jobs report and with Treasury yields above 5%, that detail may matter more than usual for investors and borrowers.
segments.tr: Après un rapport sur l'emploi faible et avec des rendements du Trésor supérieurs à 5 %, ce détail peut compter plus que d'habitude pour les investisseurs et les emprunteurs.

segments.tr: *Cet article est uniquement à des fins d'information générale et d'éducation.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: Il ne s'agit pas de conseils en investissement, fiscaux ou financiers.

segments.src: Consider consulting a qualified professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: Envisagez de consulter un professionnel qualifié avant de prendre des décisions financières.

segments.tr: Consultez le site officiel de la Réserve fédérale pour le texte intégral du compte-rendu.*
