segments.tr: Se elas parecerem mais preocupadas com o crescimento e os empregos, a reação pode ir na direção oposta.

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: As reações costumam ser de curta duração.

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: As atas refletem uma reunião que aconteceu semanas atrás, e dados mais recentes ou discursos do Fed podem mudar o cenário rapidamente.

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: Os analistas também tendem a discordar sobre o que uma determinada passagem significa.

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Trate o movimento de mercado de qualquer dia único como uma leitura do texto, não como um veredito.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## O que isso pode significar para as taxas de hipoteca e os orçamentos das famílias

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: As taxas de hipoteca não seguem a taxa de política do Fed diretamente.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: Elas tendem a acompanhar os rendimentos do Tesouro de longo prazo, juntamente com a precificação de risco dos credores e a demanda dos investidores por títulos garantidos por hipotecas.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: É por isso que os rendimentos elevados do Tesouro importam para potenciais compradores e pessoas que pensam em refinanciar.

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **Compradores de imóveis:** As taxas podem mudar entre o dia em que você faz compras e o dia em que você trava a taxa. Pergunte a um credor como funcionam os travamentos de taxa e quanto eles custam.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **Mutuários com dívida de taxa variável:** Cartões de crédito e algumas linhas de crédito garantido por imóvel respondem de forma mais direta à taxa de política do Fed. Um corte ou manutenção afetaria isso de maneira diferente de uma alta.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **Poupadores:** Os rendimentos em contas de poupança e certificados de depósito frequentemente seguem a taxa de política, embora os bancos variem na rapidez com que se ajustam.

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## Mantendo a divulgação em perspectiva

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: Alguns cuidados valem a pena ser lembrados quando as atas forem divulgadas:

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **Manchetes comprimem a nuance.** Leia as passagens reais se puder, não apenas os resumos.

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **As atas olham para trás.** Elas descrevem uma reunião passada, não necessariamente o pensamento atual.

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **As previsões são incertas.** Mesmo analistas experientes frequentemente julgam mal o momento e o tamanho das mudanças de taxa.

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **Diferentes leitores tiram conclusões diferentes.** A mesma frase pode ser tomada como dura ou branda, dependendo do leitor.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: As atas não vão decidir se o Fed vai cortar, manter ou subir as taxas.

segments.tr: Elas podem mostrar quão ampla é a divergência, com quais riscos as autoridades estão mais preocupadas e quais dados estão observando.

in.title: Membaca Risalah FOMC: Hal yang Perlu Diperhatikan pada Langkah Suku Bunga The Fed Berikutnya

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: Risalah dari rapat kebijakan terbaru Federal Reserve akan dirilis minggu ini.

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: Para investor, ekonom, dan pembeli rumah akan membacanya dengan cermat.

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.
segments.tr: Risalah tersebut tidak mengumumkan sebuah keputusan.

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: Namun, risalah itu menawarkan penjelasan yang lebih rinci tentang bagaimana para pembuat kebijakan mempertimbangkan pilihan antara memangkas, menahan, dan menaikkan suku bunga.

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.
segments.tr: Panduan ini menjelaskan apa itu risalah, apa yang perlu dicari di dalamnya, dan mengapa pemilihan kata tersebut penting bagi pasar dan keuangan rumah tangga.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## Apa itu risalah, dan bukan apa

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) menetapkan suku bunga kebijakan bank sentral.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: Beberapa minggu setelah setiap rapat, The Fed menerbitkan ringkasan diskusi tersebut.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: Risalah tersebut bukanlah transkrip verbatim, dan biasanya tidak mengaitkan pandangan dengan pejabat individu berdasarkan nama.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: Risalah tersebut umumnya mendeskripsikan diskusi dalam istilah kolektif, seperti "para peserta", "banyak peserta" atau "beberapa peserta".

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: Pemilihan kata tersebut mudah dilewatkan sekilas, tetapi para analis memperlakukannya sebagai sebuah sinyal.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"Beberapa" (several) atau "sebagian"** menyiratkan bahwa minoritas yang signifikan memiliki pandangan tertentu.

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"Banyak"** menyiratkan kelompok yang lebih besar.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"Sebagian besar" atau "hampir semua"** menandakan sesuatu yang mendekati konsensus.

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"Beberapa" (a few)** biasanya menunjuk pada kelompok kecil, yang terkadang berbeda pendapat.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: Pergeseran kata-kata ini dari satu risalah ke risalah berikutnya dapat menunjukkan apakah komite bergerak menuju kesepakatan atau semakin terpecah.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## Mengapa rilis ini menarik perhatian ekstra

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: Dua perkembangan sedang membentuk cara pembaca mendekati kumpulan risalah ini.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **Laporan pekerjaan yang lemah.** Perekrutan yang lebih lambat dapat memperkuat argumen untuk pelonggaran kebijakan. Para pejabat mungkin juga menunjukkan bahwa satu laporan adalah titik data tunggal, dan angka bulanan seringkali direvisi.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **Imbal hasil (yield) US Treasury di atas 5%.** Imbal hasil jangka panjang yang lebih tinggi memperketat kondisi keuangan dengan sendirinya. Hal ini dapat menaikkan biaya pinjaman bagi bisnis dan rumah tangga terlepas dari apa yang dilakukan The Fed dengan suku bunga jangka pendeknya. Para pejabat mungkin mendiskusikan apakah pengetatan tersebut mengurangi kebutuhan untuk tindakan lebih lanjut, atau apakah hal itu mencerminkan kekhawatiran tentang inflasi atau pinjaman pemerintah yang membutuhkan respons berbeda.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: Secara bersama-sama, pasar tenaga kerja yang lebih lunak dan imbal hasil yang tinggi membuat pertukaran komite terlihat jelas.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: Memangkas terlalu cepat dapat berisiko memicu kembali inflasi.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: Menunggu terlalu lama dapat berisiko merusak pasar tenaga kerja.

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## Lima hal yang akan dicari oleh para analis

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. Seberapa terpecahnya komite

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: Bagian yang paling dicermati menggambarkan rentang pandangan tentang jalur kebijakan.

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: Apakah diskusi tersebut dibingkai sekitar kapan harus memangkas, apakah akan berhenti sejenak, atau apakah kenaikan suku bunga masih mungkin terjadi?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: Bahkan kelompok kecil yang memunculkan kemungkinan kenaikan dapat dibaca sebagai tanda bahwa para pejabat belum menetapkan arah.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. Bagaimana para pejabat mendeskripsikan inflasi

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: Carilah apakah inflasi digambarkan membuat kemajuan menuju target 2% The Fed, atau mengalami stagnasi.

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: Pembaca juga akan mengawasi penyebutan tekanan tertentu, seperti harga jasa, biaya perumahan, energi atau tarif, dan apakah para pejabat melihatnya bersifat sementara atau persisten.

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. Bagaimana mereka membaca pasar tenaga kerja

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: Setelah laporan pekerjaan yang lemah, bahasa tentang ketenagakerjaan menjadi penting.

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: Frasa seperti "mendingin" (cooling), "melunak" (softening) atau "tangguh" (resilient) menunjukkan bagaimana para pejabat menimbang data tersebut.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: Setiap diskusi tentang risiko penurunan yang lebih tajam akan menjadi perubahan nada yang signifikan.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. Pandangan tentang kondisi keuangan dan imbal hasil

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: Para pejabat dapat berkomentar tentang kenaikan imbal hasil US Treasury, fungsi pasar, dan laju pengurangan neraca The Fed, jika itu masih dalam pembahasan.

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: Bacalah bagian-bagian ini untuk melihat apakah para pembuat kebijakan menganggap imbal hasil yang lebih tinggi sebagai bagian dari pekerjaan pengetatan The Fed.

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. Panduan tentang ketergantungan data

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: Para pembuat kebijakan sering menekankan bahwa keputusan bergantung pada data yang masuk.

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Risalah dapat menunjukkan indikator mana yang paling mereka sandarkan, seperti penggajian (payrolls), pertumbuhan upah, harga konsumen atau ekspektasi inflasi.

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: Hal itu memberi tahu pembaca laporan mendatang mana yang mungkin paling penting.

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## Mengapa pemilihan kata dapat menggerakkan pasar

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: Pasar memperdagangkan ekspektasi.

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: Jika risalah terbaca lebih berhati-hati terhadap inflasi daripada asumsi investor, harga saham dan obligasi dapat berubah, dan dolar juga dapat bergerak.

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: Jika risalah terbaca lebih khawatir tentang pertumbuhan dan pekerjaan, reaksinya bisa berjalan sebaliknya.

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: Reaksi sering kali berumur pendek.

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: Risalah mencerminkan rapat yang terjadi beberapa minggu lalu, dan data baru atau pidato The Fed dapat mengubah gambaran dengan cepat.

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: Analis juga cenderung tidak sependapat tentang arti dari suatu bagian tertentu.

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Perlakukan pergerakan pasar hari apa pun sebagai satu bacaan dari teks, bukan sebuah vonis.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi suku bunga KPR dan anggaran rumah tangga

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: Suku bunga KPR tidak mengikuti suku bunga kebijakan The Fed secara langsung.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: Suku bunga tersebut cenderung melacak imbal hasil US Treasury jangka panjang, seiring dengan penetapan harga risiko pemberi pinjaman dan permintaan investor untuk sekuritas yang didukung mortgage.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya imbal hasil US Treasury yang tinggi penting bagi calon pembeli dan orang-orang yang memikirkan pembiayaan ulang (refinancing).

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **Pembeli rumah:** Suku bunga dapat berubah antara hari Anda berbelanja dan hari Anda menguncinya (lock). Tanyakan kepada pemberi pinjaman bagaimana cara kerja penguncian suku bunga dan berapa biayanya.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **Peminjam dengan utang tingkat suku bunga variabel:** Kartu kredit dan beberapa jalur ekuitas rumah merespons lebih langsung terhadap suku bunga kebijakan The Fed. Pemangkasan atau penahanan akan memengaruhi hal ini secara berbeda dari kenaikan.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **Penabung:** Imbal hasil pada rekening tabungan dan sertifikat deposito sering mengikuti suku bunga kebijakan, meskipun bank bervariasi dalam seberapa cepat mereka menyesuaikan.

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## Menjaga rilis dalam perspektif

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: Beberapa peringatan perlu diingat ketika risalah keluar:

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **Judul utama memadatkan nuansa.** Baca bagian sebenarnya jika Anda bisa, bukan hanya ringkasan.

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **Risalah melihat ke belakang.** Mereka menggambarkan rapat masa lalu, belum tentu pemikiran saat ini.

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **Prakiraan tidak pasti.** Bahkan analis berpengalaman sering salah menilai waktu dan besarnya perubahan suku bunga.

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **Pembaca yang berbeda menarik kesimpulan yang berbeda.** Kalimat yang sama dapat dianggap hawkish atau dovish tergantung pada pembacanya.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: Risalah tidak akan menyelesaikan apakah The Fed akan memangkas, menahan, atau menaikkan suku bunga.

segments.src: They can show how wide the disagreement is, which risks officials are most worried about, and which data they are watching.
segments.tr: Risalah dapat menunjukkan seberapa besar ketidaksepakatan tersebut, risiko mana yang paling dikhawatirkan para pejabat, dan data mana yang mereka awasi.

segments.tr: Setelah laporan pekerjaan yang lemah dan dengan imbal hasil US Treasury di atas 5%, detail tersebut mungkin lebih penting dari biasanya bagi investor dan peminjam.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: 今回の議事要旨へのアプローチを形作る2つの展開があります。

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **弱い雇用統計。** 雇用の鈍化は、金融緩和の根拠を強める可能性があります。当局者はまた、1つの報告書は単なるデータポイントに過ぎず、月次統計はしばしば修正されると指摘するかもしれません。

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **5%を超える米国債利回り。** 長期金利の上昇は、それ自体が金融環境を引き締めます。FRBが短期金利をどう操作しようとも、企業や家計の借入コストを上昇させる可能性があります。当局者は、その引き締めが追加行動の必要性を減らすのか、それともインフレや政府の借入に対する懸念を反映しており、異なる対応が必要なのかを議論するかもしれません。

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: 労働市場の軟化と利回りの上昇は、委員会のトレードオフを明白にしています。

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: 早すぎる利下げは、インフレを再燃させるリスクがあります。

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: 待ちすぎると、労働市場を傷つけるリスクがあります。

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## アナリストが注目する5つのポイント

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. 委員会の分裂度合い

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: 最も注目されるのは、政策の方向性に関する見解の幅を記述した箇所です。

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: 議論は、いつ利下げするか、一時停止するか、それとも利上げの可能性があるか、という枠組みで行われているでしょうか？

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: たとえ少数のグループであっても利上げの可能性を提起していれば、当局者が方向性を決めていない兆候として読み取ることができます。

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. 当局者がインフレをどう表現しているか

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: インフレがFRBの2%目標に向けて進展していると表現されているか、それとも停滞していると表現されているかに注目してください。

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: 読者はまた、サービス価格、住宅コスト、エネルギー、関税といった特定の圧力への言及や、当局者がそれらを一時的と見ているか持続的と見ているかにも注目します。

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. 労働市場をどう読んでいるか

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: 弱い雇用統計の後では、雇用に関する言葉遣いが重要になります。

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: "cooling"（冷え込み）、"softening"（軟化）、"resilient"（回復力がある）といったフレーズは、当局者がデータをどう評価しているかを示しています。

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: より深刻な景気後退のリスクに関する議論があれば、それはトーンの顕著な変化となるでしょう。

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. 金融環境と利回りに関する見解

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: 当局者は、上昇する米国債利回り、市場の機能、そしてもし議論が続いているのであればFRBのバランスシート縮小のペースについてコメントするかもしれません。

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: 政策立案者が、利回りの上昇をFRBの引き締め作業の一部と見なしているかどうか、これらの箇所を読んでください。

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. データ依存に関するガイダンス

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: 政策立案者は、決定が入手可能なデータに依存していることを強調することがよくあります。

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: 議事要旨は、彼らが雇用統計、賃金の伸び、消費者物価、インフレ期待など、どの指標を最も重視しているかを示してくれます。

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: それは、今後のどの報告書が最も重要になるかを読者に伝えます。

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## なぜ文言が市場を動かすのか

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: 市場は期待に基づいて取引されます。

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: もし議事要旨が投資家の想定よりもインフレに対して慎重な内容であれば、株式や債券の価格が変動し、ドルも動く可能性があります。

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: もし成長や雇用に対してより懸念を示していると読めれば、反応は逆の方向に向かう可能性があります。

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: 反応は短命であることが多いです。

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: 議事要旨は数週間前に行われた会合を反映しており、新しいデータやFRBの講演が状況をすぐに変えてしまう可能性があります。

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: また、アナリストは特定の箇所が何を意味するかについて意見が分かれる傾向があります。

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: ある一日の市場の動きを、テキストの決定的な解釈ではなく、一つの読み方として扱うようにしてください。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## 住宅ローン金利と家計への影響

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: 住宅ローン金利は、FRBの政策金利に直接連動するわけではありません。

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: それらは、貸し手のリスク価格設定や住宅ローン担保証券（MBS）への投資家需要とともに、長期の米国債利回りに追随する傾向があります。

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: だからこそ、米国債利回りの上昇は、住宅購入予定者や借り換えを検討している人々にとって重要なのです。

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **住宅購入者：** 金利は、物件を探している日と契約を確定する日の間で変わる可能性があります。貸し手に金利固定の仕組みとコストについて尋ねてください。

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **変動金利の借り手：** クレジットカードや一部のホームエクイティラインは、FRBの政策金利により直接的に反応します。利下げや据え置きは、利上げとは異なる影響をこれらに与えます。

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **預金者：** 普通預金や定期預金の利回りは政策金利に追随することが多いですが、銀行によって調整の速さは異なります。

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## 発表を冷静に受け止めるために

segments.src: A few cautions are worth remembering when the minutes come out:
segments.tr: 議事要旨が発表される際には、いくつかの注意点を覚えておく価値があります：

segments.src: - **Headlines compress nuance.** Read the actual passages if you can, not just summaries.
segments.tr: - **見出しはニュアンスを圧縮します。** 可能であれば要約だけでなく、実際の文章を読んでください。

segments.src: - **The minutes look backward.** They describe a past meeting, not necessarily current thinking.
segments.tr: - **議事要旨は過去を振り返るものです。** 過去の会合を記述したものであり、必ずしも現在の考えを反映しているとは限りません。

segments.src: - **Forecasts are uncertain.** Even experienced analysts often misjudge the timing and size of rate changes.
segments.tr: - **予測は不確実です。** 経験豊富なアナリストでさえ、利上げ・利下げのタイミングや規模を誤ることがよくあります。

segments.src: - **Different readers draw different conclusions.** The same sentence may be taken as hawkish or dovish depending on the reader.
segments.tr: - **読者によって結論が異なります。** 同じ文章でも、読者によってはタカ派的ともハト派的とも受け取られることがあります。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The minutes won't settle whether the Fed will cut, hold or hike.
segments.tr: 議事要旨は、FRBが利下げ、据え置き、利上げのどれを行うかを決定づけるものではありません。

segments.src: They can show how wide the disagreement is, which risks officials are most worried about, and which data they are watching.
segments.tr: しかし、意見の不一致がどの程度か、当局者がどのリスクを最も懸念しているか、どのデータを注視しているかを示すことはできます。

segments.src: After a weak jobs report and with Treasury yields above 5%, that detail may matter more than usual for investors and borrowers.
segments.tr: 弱い雇用統計と5%を超える米国債利回りの状況下では、その詳細が投資家や借り手にとって通常よりも重要になる可能性があります。

segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供と教育のみを目的としています。

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.
segments.tr: 投資、税務、財務に関するアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Consider consulting a qualified professional before making financial decisions.
segments.tr: 財務上の決定を下す前に、資格のある専門家に相談することを検討してください。

segments.src: Check the Federal Reserve's official website for the full text of the minutes.*
segments.tr: 議事要旨の全文については、連邦準備制度の公式サイトを確認してください。*

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## Was das Protokoll ist und was nicht

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: Das Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) legt den Leitzins der Zentralbank fest.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: Einige Wochen nach jeder Sitzung veröffentlicht die Fed eine Zusammenfassung der Diskussion.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: Das Protokoll ist kein wörtliches Transkript und schreibt Ansichten normalerweise nicht namentlich einzelnen Beamten zu.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: Es beschreibt die Diskussion typischerweise in kollektiven Begriffen wie "Teilnehmer", "viele Teilnehmer" oder "einige Teilnehmer".

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: Diese Wortwahl ist leicht zu überlesen, aber Analysten behandeln sie als Signal.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"Mehrere" oder "einige"** deutet darauf hin, dass eine bedeutende Minderheit eine Ansicht vertritt.

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"Viele"** deutet auf eine größere Gruppe hin.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"Die meisten" oder "fast alle"** signalisiert etwas, das einem Konsens nahekommt.

segments.src: - **"A few"** usually points to a small, sometimes dissenting, group.
segments.tr: - **"Einige wenige"** weist normalerweise auf eine kleine, manchmal abweichende Gruppe hin.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: Verschiebungen in diesen Formulierungen von einem Protokoll zum nächsten können zeigen, ob sich das Komitee auf eine Einigung zubewegt oder sich weiter spaltet.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## Warum diese Veröffentlichung besondere Aufmerksamkeit erregt

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: Zwei Entwicklungen prägen, wie Leser an dieses Protokoll herangehen.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **Ein schwacher Arbeitsmarktbericht.** Langsamere Neueinstellungen können das Argument für eine Lockerung der Geldpolitik stärken. Beamte könnten auch darauf hinweisen, dass ein Bericht nur ein einzelner Datenpunkt ist und monatliche Zahlen oft revidiert werden.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **Staatsanleiherenditen über 5%.** Höhere langfristige Renditen straffen die finanziellen Bedingungen von sich aus. Sie können die Kreditkosten für Unternehmen und Haushalte erhöhen, unabhängig davon, was die Fed mit ihrem Leitzins tut. Beamte könnten diskutieren, ob diese Straffung die Notwendigkeit für weitere Maßnahmen verringert oder ob sie Bedenken hinsichtlich der Inflation oder der Staatsverschuldung widerspiegelt, die eine andere Reaktion erfordern.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: Zusammen machen ein schwächerer Arbeitsmarkt und erhöhte Renditen die Zielkonflikte des Komitees deutlich sichtbar.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: Ein zu frühes Senken der Zinsen könnte das Risiko bergen, die Inflation wieder anzuheizen.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: Zu langes Warten könnte das Risiko bergen, dem Arbeitsmarkt zu schaden.

segments.tr: Dreht sich die Diskussion darum, wann gesenkt werden soll, ob eine Pause eingelegt werden soll oder ob eine Zinserhöhung weiterhin möglich ist?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: Selbst eine kleine Gruppe, die die Möglichkeit einer Anhebung zur Sprache bringt, kann als Zeichen dafür gewertet werden, dass sich die Beamten über die Richtung noch nicht einig sind.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation

segments.tr: Phrasen wie "abkühlend", "abschwächend" oder "widerstandsfähig" zeigen, wie die Beamten die Daten gewichten.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: Märkte handeln auf Basis von Erwartungen.

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: Wenn das Protokoll in Bezug auf die Inflation vorsichtiger klingt, als Investoren angenommen hatten, können sich Aktien- und Anleihekurse verschieben, und auch der Dollar könnte sich bewegen.

segments.tr: Wenn es besorgter über Wachstum und Arbeitsplätze klingt, kann die Reaktion in die andere Richtung verlaufen.

segments.tr: Reaktionen sind oft von kurzer Dauer.

segments.tr: Das Protokoll spiegelt eine Sitzung wider, die Wochen zurückliegt, und neuere Daten oder Reden der Fed können das Bild schnell ändern.

segments.tr: Analysten sind sich auch oft uneinig darüber, was eine bestimmte Passage bedeutet.

segments.tr: Betrachten Sie die Marktbewegung eines einzelnen Tages als eine Lesart des Textes, nicht als Urteil.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## Was es für Hypothekenzinsen und Haushaltsbudgets bedeuten könnte

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: Hypothekenzinsen folgen nicht direkt dem Leitzins der Fed.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: Sie tendieren dazu, langfristigen Staatsanleiherenditen zu folgen, zusammen mit der Risikobepreisung der Kreditgeber und der Nachfrage der Investoren nach hypothekenbesicherten Wertpapieren.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: Deshalb sind erhöhte Staatsanleiherenditen für potenzielle Käufer und Menschen, die über eine Refinanzierung nachdenken, wichtig.

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **Kreditnehmer mit variabel verzinsten Schulden:** Kreditkarten und einige Eigenheimkreditlinien reagieren direkter auf den Leitzins der Fed. Eine Senkung oder Beibehaltung würde diese anders beeinflussen als eine Erhöhung.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **Sparer:** Renditen auf Sparkonten und Festgelder folgen oft dem Leitzins, obwohl Banken unterschiedlich schnell anpassen.

vi.title: Đọc biên bản cuộc họp của FOMC: Những điều cần chú ý trong đợt điều chỉnh lãi suất tiếp theo của Fed

segments.src: The minutes of the Federal Reserve's most recent policy meeting are due this week.
segments.tr: Biên bản cuộc họp chính sách gần đây nhất của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang dự kiến sẽ được công bố trong tuần này.

segments.src: Investors, economists and homebuyers will read them closely.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư, nhà kinh tế và người mua nhà sẽ đọc kỹ lưỡng tài liệu này.

segments.src: The minutes don't announce a decision.
segments.tr: Biên bản không công bố quyết định nào.

segments.src: They do offer a more detailed account of how policymakers weighed the choice between cutting, holding and raising interest rates.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, tài liệu này cung cấp một bản tường thuật chi tiết hơn về cách các nhà hoạch định chính sách cân nhắc giữa việc cắt giảm, giữ nguyên và tăng lãi suất.

segments.src: This guide explains what the minutes are, what to look for in them, and why the wording can matter for markets and household finances.
segments.tr: Hướng dẫn này giải thích biên bản là gì, những điểm cần tìm kiếm trong đó và lý do tại sao câu chữ lại quan trọng đối với thị trường và tài chính hộ gia đình.

segments.src: ## What the minutes are, and what they aren't
segments.tr: ## Biên bản là gì và không phải là gì

segments.src: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets the central bank's policy rate.
segments.tr: Ủy ban Thị trường Mở Liên bang (FOMC) thiết lập lãi suất chính sách của ngân hàng trung ương.

segments.src: A few weeks after each meeting, the Fed publishes a summary of the discussion.
segments.tr: Vài tuần sau mỗi cuộc họp, Fed công bố một bản tóm tắt cuộc thảo luận.

segments.src: The minutes are not a verbatim transcript, and they usually don't attribute views to individual officials by name.
segments.tr: Biên bản không phải là bản ghi chép nguyên văn và thường không quy kết quan điểm cho từng quan chức cụ thể bằng tên.

segments.src: They typically describe the discussion in collective terms, such as "participants," "many participants" or "a few participants."
segments.tr: Tài liệu này thường mô tả cuộc thảo luận theo thuật ngữ tập thể, chẳng hạn như "những người tham gia", "nhiều người tham gia" hoặc "một số ít người tham gia".

segments.src: That wording is easy to skim past, but analysts treat it as a signal.
segments.tr: Cách dùng từ đó rất dễ lướt qua, nhưng các nhà phân tích coi đó là một tín hiệu.

segments.src: - **"Several" or "some"** suggests a meaningful minority holds a view.
segments.tr: - **"Several" or

segments.src: - **"Many"** suggests a larger group.
segments.tr: - **"Many"** cho thấy một nhóm lớn hơn.

segments.src: - **"Most" or "almost all"** signals something close to a consensus.
segments.tr: - **"Most" or

segments.tr: - **"A few"** thường chỉ một nhóm nhỏ, đôi khi có quan điểm bất đồng.

segments.src: Shifts in these words from one set of minutes to the next can show whether the committee is moving toward agreement or splitting further apart.
segments.tr: Sự thay đổi trong các từ ngữ này từ bộ biên bản này sang bộ biên bản tiếp theo có thể cho thấy liệu ủy ban đang hướng tới sự đồng thuận hay ngày càng chia rẽ hơn.

segments.src: ## Why this release is drawing extra attention
segments.tr: ## Tại sao bản phát hành này thu hút sự chú ý đặc biệt

segments.src: Two developments are shaping how readers approach this set of minutes.
segments.tr: Hai diễn biến đang định hình cách người đọc tiếp cận bộ biên bản này.

segments.src: 1. **A weak jobs report.** Slower hiring can strengthen the case for easing policy. Officials may also point out that one report is a single data point, and monthly figures are often revised.
segments.tr: 1. **Báo cáo việc làm yếu kém.** Việc tuyển dụng chậm hơn có thể củng cố lập luận cho việc nới lỏng chính sách. Các quan chức cũng có thể chỉ ra rằng một báo cáo chỉ là một điểm dữ liệu đơn lẻ và các số liệu hàng tháng thường xuyên được điều chỉnh.

segments.src: 2. **Treasury yields above 5%.** Higher long-term yields tighten financial conditions on their own. They can raise borrowing costs for businesses and households whatever the Fed does with its short-term rate. Officials may discuss whether that tightening reduces the need for further action, or whether it reflects concerns about inflation or government borrowing that call for a different response.
segments.tr: 2. **Lợi suất Trái phiếu Kho bạc trên 5%.** Lợi suất dài hạn cao hơn tự thân nó thắt chặt các điều kiện tài chính. Chúng có thể làm tăng chi phí đi vay đối với các doanh nghiệp và hộ gia đình bất kể Fed làm gì với lãi suất ngắn hạn của mình. Các quan chức có thể thảo luận xem việc thắt chặt đó có làm giảm nhu cầu hành động tiếp theo hay không, hay liệu nó phản ánh những lo ngại về lạm inflación hoặc vay mượn chính phủ đòi hỏi một phản ứng khác.

segments.src: Together, a softer labor market and elevated yields put the committee's trade-offs in plain view.
segments.tr: Nhìn chung, thị trường lao động ảm đạm hơn và lợi suất tăng cao làm nổi bật rõ ràng những sự đánh đổi của ủy ban.

segments.src: Cutting too soon could risk reigniting inflation.
segments.tr: Việc cắt giảm quá sớm có thể có nguy cơ làm bùng phát lạm phát trở lại.

segments.src: Waiting too long could risk damaging the job market.
segments.tr: Chờ đợi quá lâu có thể có nguy cơ gây tổn hại đến thị trường việc làm.

segments.src: ## Five things analysts will look for
segments.tr: ## Năm điều các nhà phân tích sẽ tìm kiếm

segments.src: ### 1. How divided the committee is
segments.tr: ### 1. Mức độ chia rẽ của ủy ban

segments.src: The most closely watched passages describe the range of views on the policy path.
segments.tr: Các đoạn được theo dõi sát sao nhất mô tả phạm vi quan điểm về lộ trình chính sách.

segments.src: Is the discussion framed around when to cut, whether to pause, or whether a rate increase remains possible?
segments.tr: Cuộc thảo luận có được đóng khung xung quanh thời điểm cắt giảm, có nên tạm dừng hay không, hoặc liệu việc tăng lãi suất có còn khả thi không?

segments.src: Even a small group raising the possibility of a hike can be read as a sign that officials aren't settled on direction.
segments.tr: Ngay cả một nhóm nhỏ nêu lên khả năng tăng lãi suất cũng có thể được coi là dấu hiệu cho thấy các quan chức chưa chốt hướng đi.

segments.src: ### 2. How officials describe inflation
segments.tr: ### 2. Cách các quan chức mô tả lạm phát

segments.src: Look for whether inflation is described as making progress toward the Fed's 2% goal, or as stalling.
segments.tr: Hãy tìm xem liệu lạm phát được mô tả là đang tiến triển hướng tới mục tiêu 2% của Fed hay đang chững lại.

segments.src: Readers will also watch for mentions of specific pressures, such as services prices, housing costs, energy or tariffs, and whether officials see them as temporary or persistent.
segments.tr: Người đọc cũng sẽ chú ý đến các đề cập về những áp lực cụ thể, chẳng hạn như giá dịch vụ, chi phí nhà ở, năng lượng hoặc thuế quan, và liệu các quan chức có coi chúng là tạm thời hay dai dẳng.

segments.src: ### 3. How they read the labor market
segments.tr: ### 3. Cách họ đọc thị trường lao động

segments.src: After a weak jobs report, the language on employment matters.
segments.tr: Sau một báo cáo việc làm yếu kém, ngôn từ về việc làm rất quan trọng.

segments.src: Phrases like "cooling," "softening" or "resilient" show how officials are weighing the data.
segments.tr: Các cụm từ như "hạ nhiệt", "mềm hóa" hoặc "kiên cường" cho thấy cách các quan chức đang cân nhắc dữ liệu.

segments.src: Any discussion of the risk of a sharper downturn would be a notable change in tone.
segments.tr: Bất kỳ cuộc thảo luận nào về nguy cơ suy thoái trầm trọng hơn sẽ là một sự thay đổi đáng chú ý về tông giọng.

segments.src: ### 4. Views on financial conditions and yields
segments.tr: ### 4. Quan điểm về điều kiện tài chính và lợi suất

segments.src: Officials may comment on rising Treasury yields, market functioning and the pace of the Fed's balance sheet reduction, if that is still under discussion.
segments.tr: Các quan chức có thể bình luận về việc lợi suất Trái phiếu Kho bạc tăng, hoạt động của thị trường và tốc độ giảm quy mô bảng cân đối kế toán của Fed, nếu điều đó vẫn đang được thảo luận.

segments.src: Read these passages for whether policymakers see higher yields as doing some of the Fed's tightening work.
segments.tr: Hãy đọc những đoạn này để xem liệu các nhà hoạch định chính sách có coi lợi suất cao hơn là một phần công việc thắt chặt của Fed hay không.

segments.src: ### 5. Guidance on data dependence
segments.tr: ### 5. Hướng dẫn về sự phụ thuộc vào dữ liệu

segments.src: Policymakers often stress that decisions depend on incoming data.
segments.tr: Các nhà hoạch định chính sách thường nhấn mạnh rằng các quyết định phụ thuộc vào dữ liệu sắp tới.

segments.src: The minutes can show which indicators they are leaning on most, such as payrolls, wage growth, consumer prices or inflation expectations.
segments.tr: Biên bản có thể cho thấy các chỉ báo nào họ đang nghiêng về nhiều nhất, chẳng hạn như bảng lương, tăng trưởng tiền lương, giá tiêu dùng hoặc kỳ vọng lạm phát.

segments.src: That tells readers which upcoming reports could matter most.
segments.tr: Điều đó cho người đọc biết báo cáo sắp tới nào có thể quan trọng nhất.

segments.src: ## Why the wording can move markets
segments.tr: ## Tại sao câu chữ có thể làm chuyển động thị trường

segments.src: Markets trade on expectations.
segments.tr: Thị trường giao dịch dựa trên kỳ vọng.

segments.src: If the minutes read as more cautious about inflation than investors assumed, stock and bond prices can shift, and the dollar may move as well.
segments.tr: Nếu biên bản tỏ ra thận trọng hơn về lạm phát so với giả định của các nhà đầu tư, giá cổ phiếu và trái phiếu có thể thay đổi, và đồng đô la cũng có thể di chuyển.

segments.src: If they read as more concerned about growth and jobs, the reaction can run the other way.
segments.tr: Nếu họ tỏ ra quan tâm nhiều hơn đến tăng trưởng và việc làm, phản ứng có thể theo chiều ngược lại.

segments.src: Reactions are often short-lived.
segments.tr: Các phản ứng thường diễn ra trong thời gian ngắn.

segments.src: The minutes reflect a meeting that happened weeks ago, and newer data or Fed speeches can change the picture quickly.
segments.tr: Biên bản phản ánh một cuộc họp diễn ra từ nhiều tuần trước và dữ liệu mới hơn hoặc các bài phát biểu của Fed có thể thay đổi bức tranh một cách nhanh chóng.

segments.src: Analysts also tend to disagree about what a given passage means.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích cũng có xu hướng không đồng tình về ý nghĩa của một đoạn văn nhất định.

segments.src: Treat any single day's market move as one reading of the text, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Hãy coi chuyển động thị trường của bất kỳ ngày đơn lẻ nào như một cách đọc văn bản, chứ không phải là một phán quyết.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for mortgage rates and household budgets
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với lãi suất thế chấp và ngân sách hộ gia đình

segments.src: Mortgage rates don't follow the Fed's policy rate directly.
segments.tr: Lãi suất thế chấp không đi theo trực tiếp lãi suất chính sách của Fed.

segments.src: They tend to track longer-term Treasury yields, along with lenders' risk pricing and investor demand for mortgage-backed securities.
segments.tr: Chúng có xu hướng theo dõi lợi suất Trái phiếu Kho bạc dài hạn, cùng với việc định giá rủi ro của người cho vay và nhu cầu của nhà đầu tư đối với chứng khoán được bảo đảm bằng thế chấp.

segments.src: That's why elevated Treasury yields matter to prospective buyers and people thinking about refinancing.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao lợi suất Trái phiếu Kho bạc tăng cao lại quan trọng đối với những người mua tiềm năng và những người đang suy nghĩ về việc tái tài trợ.

segments.src: - **Homebuyers:** Rates can change between the day you shop and the day you lock. Ask a lender how rate locks work and what they cost.
segments.tr: - **Homebuyers:** Lãi suất có thể thay đổi giữa ngày bạn mua sắm và ngày bạn chốt lãi suất. Hãy hỏi người cho vay cách thức hoạt động của việc chốt lãi suất và chi phí của chúng.

segments.src: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Credit cards and some home equity lines respond more directly to the Fed's policy rate. A cut or hold would affect these differently than a hike.
segments.tr: - **Borrowers with variable-rate debt:** Thẻ tín dụng và một số khoản vay vốn chủ sở hữu nhà phản ứng trực tiếp hơn với lãi suất chính sách của Fed. Việc cắt giảm hoặc giữ nguyên sẽ tác động đến những yếu tố này khác với việc tăng lãi suất.

segments.src: - **Savers:** Yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit often follow the policy rate, though banks vary in how quickly they adjust.
segments.tr: - **Savers:** Lợi suất tài khoản tiết kiệm và chứng chỉ tiền gửi thường theo sát lãi suất chính sách, mặc dù các ngân hàng có tốc độ điều chỉnh khác nhau.

segments.src: ## Keeping the release in perspective
segments.tr: ## Giữ góc nhìn toàn cảnh về bản phát hành

segments.tr: - **Headlines compress nuance:** Hãy đọc các đoạn thực tế nếu có thể, không chỉ các bản tóm tắt.

segments.tr: - **The minutes look backward:** Chúng mô tả một cuộc họp trong quá khứ, không nhất thiết là suy nghĩ hiện tại.
